items.html: Now, each EKYE from these three, takes all twenty-two letters, which are implied in the Kamatz-Patach, to make vessels out of them through the looking of the Ayin in them. Thus, each of their names EKYE includes all twenty-two letters. Thus, the three names EKYE with the three times twenty-two letters, with the Kolel [with itself], amount to 130, which is Ayin in Gematria. This is how the name SAG is implied in the Ayin, too.
